scope: Diagnosis of the private sigframe-roundtrip-amd64 probe; not FEX runtime qualification

findings.meaning: The success-message path reads memory at address22 instead of loading immediate length22.
The failure-message path also dereferences a low address instead of loading immediate length24.

conclusion: This probe can fault after its signal assertions independently of signal restoration. Its exit139 is insufficient evidence of a FEX signal-context defect.
nextAction: Correct assembly immediate operands, verify resulting machine code, and rerun unchanged and edited context probes against identified FEX binaries.
limitations: The inspected ELF is authoritative; a nearby original.S copy has different message length and is not asserted to be its exact source.
Does not establish that the FEX candidate is correct; SIGURG and concurrent Go workload failures remain unresolved.
